name: stands_flat_floor
what: the whole fly in closed loop on the flat floor with no stimulus for 1 s; it stands if over the last 500 ms only its feet (tarsal segments) touch the floor and its head is at least 0.1 mm above the motor-silenced collapse (Wang 2025's lowest standing height). The model lies down today (F-STAND-3 to 6)

harness.note: flyemu.organism.Organism with the body stepped and every sense reaching the brain, the loop of flyemu.run (observe, sense, network step, motor step); seeded default_rng(seed); noise per profile

readout.note: the c_thorax body's world-frame position (mm) sampled every 1 ms after the motor step: height median, minimum and last sample over window_ms, and the horizontal drift from first to last sample. Over stand_window_ms: the c_head body origin's height above collapsed_head_mm (median, minimum), the share of samples where the floor pushes (normal force > 0) on any body that is not a tarsal segment and which bodies, and the median number of legs with a tarsal segment on the floor. collapsed_head_mm: this body's head point after motor silencing (derived: S1 level 0, m10f0, adhesion 1, 3 s; runs/s13/bypass/s1/support/s1_m10f0_adh1.json heights_final_mm.head), the zero of Wang 2025's heights

bar_source: DECISIONS 21 Oct 02:33 (bars decided by the Director as Ben, 21 Oct; reversible): only the feet touch the floor over the last 500 ms, and the height inside the measured standing range (read at the head point Wang tracked)
reference_script: python -m flyemu.run --tree . (defaults: m10f0, seed 12, flat floor, no stimulus) --ms 1000: the F-ZIP-1 tree run, spikes_sha256 770807852827186b and final_qpos_sha256 3ec293bad4b3b7b7 (runs/s22/fly2_zip/run_tree)
evidence_status: engineering seed 12 (register: F-ZIP-1 identity seeds). Wang 2025's median head height was spent as an instrument setting in s13 (S1 fix 1, --head-mm, not the default); this bar defines standing and is not held-out evidence

reference.source: Wang et al. 2025 eLife RP107390 (PMC12324252): a tracked head point of free-standing flies before motor silencing; Fig 5C 'the starting height varies from 0.4 mm to 0.1 mm in this fly'; Methods 'the median height of the fly was 0.5 mm' (measured). Zero = the collapsed position (inferred, DECISIONS 13 Oct 23:16). No population maximum is published, so there is no upper bound
